svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Product organization subtitle: Three levels, from the chief product officer to the teams, as an org chart kind: tree # Icons with the label under them are narrower than cards, so the seven teams fit one row at full # size; each unit gets an icon of its own. nodes: cpo: { icon: generic:manager, label: Chief Product Officer, note: Strategy and roadmap } design: { icon: tabler:palette, label: Design, note: 9 people } engineering: { icon: generic:code, label: Engineering, note: 24 people } pm: { icon: tabler:compass, label: Product management, note: 7 people } research: { icon: generic:search, label: User research } brand: { icon: tabler:brush, label: Brand and UI } platform: { icon: generic:server, label: Platform } web: { icon: generic:browser, label: Web app } mobile: { icon: generic:mobile, label: Mobile apps } growth: { icon: generic:metrics, label: Growth } payments: { icon: generic:payment, label: Payments } edges: - cpo -> design, engineering, pm - design -> research, brand - engineering -> platform, web, mobile - pm -> growth, payments

svg.title: Product organization
svg.desc: Product organization. 11 components. Connections: Chief Product Officer to Design; Chief Product Officer to Engineering; Chief Product Officer to Product management; Design to User research; Design to Brand and UI; Engineering to Platform; Engineering to Web app; Engineering to Mobile apps; Product management to Growth; Product management to Payments.

text.tspan: Three levels, from the chief product officer to the teams, as an org chart
